text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Abu Dhabi increased its stake in Gulf Air to about two-thirds from an original 25 percent.
- Bahrain's businessmen meet on Tuesday to discuss the implications of proposed amendments to the commercial agencies law.
- Bahrain complains about "fabrications" by Qatar's foreign minister who accused Bahrain of participating in a foiled coup attempt in February.
- A plan to link Bahrain bourse with exchanges of Egypt and Jordan has been completed, awaits approval.
- Arabic Insurance Group to launch a new life insurance company with a capital of $50 million.
- Islamic Development Bank financed projects worth $13 billion in member states since 1975.
